summary.text: Extreme serene mind tea is tea created with rank eight immortal materials, with a fragrance like soil after rain.

claims.text: Lu Wei Yin serves Fang Yuan extreme serene mind tea in a wooden cabin atop the tallest mountain in Mushroomman Paradise, also called Virtue Paradise. After boiling, the cup cools within a few breaths. Drunk in large mouthfuls, it carries a gentle coolness into the organs, sweeping internal heatiness and leaving a mellow, refreshing taste with a trace of sweetness.

One bowl adds one thousand earth path dao marks to Fang Yuan’s body, compared with about seven hundred and fifty from a heavenly tribulation and two hundred and fifty from an earthly calamity. Lu Wei Yin says Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable created the tea while living in Virtue Paradise after becoming venerable, and left food path gains in the Virtue true inheritance. The tea is essentially a food path killer move formed by expending rank eight immortal materials, so it can add earth path dao marks.

Lu Wei Yin notes the method’s cost is high: one bowl uses a large number of rank eight earth path immortal materials to give only several hundred earth path dao marks to an ordinary drinker, while Fang Yuan’s sovereign immortal body gains more because it has no conflicting dao marks.
